047public class PartialIntAnalyzer {
048
049    private final Analysis analysis;
050    private final Map<AstClafer, Concept> conceptMap = new HashMap<>();
051    private final Map<Concept, AstClafer> claferMap = new HashMap<>();
052    private final KnowledgeDatabase knowledgeDatabase = new KnowledgeDatabase();
053
054    private PartialIntAnalyzer(Analysis analysis) {
055        this.analysis = analysis;
056    }
057
058    private Concept asConcept(AstClafer clafer) {
059        Concept concept = conceptMap.get(clafer);
060        if (concept == null) {
061            concept = knowledgeDatabase.newConcept(clafer.getName());
062            conceptMap.put(clafer, concept);
063            claferMap.put(concept, clafer);
064        }
065        return concept;
066    }
067
068    private AstClafer asClafer(Concept concept) {
069        return claferMap.get(concept);
070    }
071
072    public static Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
073        PartialIntAnalyzer analyzer = new PartialIntAnalyzer(analysis);
074
075        analysis.getClafers().forEach(analyzer::analyzeClafer);
076
077        for (Entry<AstConstraint, AstBoolExpr> constraintExpr : analysis.getConstraintExprs().entrySet()) {
078            AstConstraint constraint = constraintExpr.getKey();
079            AstBoolExpr expr = constraintExpr.getValue();
080
081            if (analysis.isHard(constraint)) {
082                analyzer.analyzeConstraint(expr, constraint.getContext(), null);
083            }
084        }
085
086        Oracle oracle = analyzer.knowledgeDatabase.oracle();
087        do {
088            for (Entry<AstConstraint, AstBoolExpr> constraintExpr : analysis.getConstraintExprs().entrySet()) {
089                AstConstraint constraint = constraintExpr.getKey();
090                AstBoolExpr expr = constraintExpr.getValue();
091
092                if (analysis.isHard(constraint)) {
093                    analyzer.analyzeConstraint(expr, constraint.getContext(), oracle);
094                }
095            }
096        } while (oracle.propagate());
097
098        Map<AstConcreteClafer, Domain[]> partialInts = analyzer.partialInts(oracle);
099        return analysis.setPartialIntsMap(partialInts);
100    }
101
102    /**
103     * Returns a map from Clafer to a set of covering paths reaching that
104     * Clafer.
105     *
106     * Each Clafer maps to a two dimensional array of Paths. The first dimension
107     * is for the id of the Clafer. The second dimension contains the set of
108     * covering paths for that (Clafer, id) pair.
109     *
110     * Uses dynamic programming, which works well unless of the hierarchy
111     * contains circularity.
112     *
113     * @return a map from Clafer to a set of covering paths reaching that Clafer
114     */
115    private Map<AstClafer, Path[][]> pathsToClafers() {
116        Map<AstClafer, Path[][]> pathsToClafers = new HashMap<>(analysis.getClafers().size());
117
118        // For each potential (Clafer, id) pair, find all paths that can reach it.
119        for (Set<AstClafer> component : analysis.getClafersInParentAndSubOrder()) {
120            for (AstClafer clafer : component) {
121                PartialSolution partialSolution = analysis.getPartialSolution(clafer);
122                Path[][] paths = new Path[partialSolution.size()][];
123                if (clafer instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
124                    AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer = (AstAbstractClafer) clafer;
125                    Offsets offsets = analysis.getOffsets(abstractClafer);
126                    for (AstClafer sub : abstractClafer.getSubs()) {
127                        int offset = offsets.getOffset(sub);
128                        Path[][] subPaths = pathsToClafers.get(sub);
129                        if (subPaths == null) {
130                            // This can occur if circularity in hierarcy.
131                            Arrays.fill(paths, new Path[]{new Path(asConcept(clafer))});
132                            break;
133                        }
134                        System.arraycopy(subPaths, 0, paths, offset, subPaths.length);
135                    }
136                } else {
137                    if (clafer.hasParent()) {
138                        Concept concept = asConcept(clafer);
139                        Path[][] parentPaths = pathsToClafers.get(clafer.getParent());
140                        if (parentPaths == null) {
141                            // This can occur if circularity in hierarcy.
142                            Arrays.fill(paths, new Path[]{new Path(asConcept(clafer))});
143                        } else {
144                            Path[][] childPaths = new Path[parentPaths.length][];
145                            for (int i = 0; i < childPaths.length; i++) {
146                                childPaths[i] = new Path[parentPaths[i].length];
147                                for (int j = 0; j < childPaths[i].length; j++) {
148                                    childPaths[i][j] = parentPaths[i][j].append(concept);
149                                }
150                            }
151                            for (int i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
152                                int[] possibleParents = partialSolution.getPossibleParents(i);
153                                int size = 0;
154                                for (int possibleParent : possibleParents) {
155                                    size += childPaths[possibleParent].length;
156                                }
157                                Path[] pathsForId = new Path[size];
158                                int offset = 0;
159                                for (int possibleParent : possibleParents) {
160                                    System.arraycopy(
161                                            childPaths[possibleParent], 0,
162                                            pathsForId, offset,
163                                            childPaths[possibleParent].length);
164                                    offset += childPaths[possibleParent].length;
165                                }
166                                paths[i] = pathsForId;
167                            }
168                        }
169                    } else {
170                        Arrays.fill(paths, new Path[]{new Path(asConcept(clafer))});
171                    }
172                }
173                pathsToClafers.put(clafer, paths);
174            }
175        }
176        return pathsToClafers;
177    }
178
179    private Map<AstConcreteClafer, Domain[]> partialInts(Oracle oracle) {
180        Map<AstClafer, Path[][]> pathsToClafers = pathsToClafers();
181
182        Map<AstConcreteClafer, Domain[]> partialInts = new HashMap<>();
183        for (AstConcreteClafer clafer : analysis.getConcreteClafers()) {
184            AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
185            if (ref != null) {
186                Path[][] paths = pathsToClafers.get(clafer);
187                Domain[] domains = new Domain[paths.length];
188                for (int i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
189                    Domain domain = Domains.EmptyDomain;
190                    for (Path path : paths[i]) {
191                        Domain pathDomain = oracle.getAssignment(path);
192                        if (pathDomain == null) {
193                            domain = null;
194                            break;
195                        }
196                        domain = domain.union(pathDomain);
197                    }
198                    domains[i] = domain;
199                }
200                partialInts.put(clafer, domains);
201            }
202        }
203        return partialInts;
204    }
205
206    private void analyzeClafer(AstClafer clafer) {
207        if (clafer.hasSuperClafer()) {
208            knowledgeDatabase.newIsA(asConcept(clafer), asConcept(clafer.getSuperClafer()));
209        }
210        clafer.getChildren().forEach(child
211                -> knowledgeDatabase.newHasA(asConcept(clafer), asConcept(child)));
212    }
213
214    private void analyzeConstraint(AstBoolExpr expr, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
215        Either<Conjunction, Disjunction> conjOrDisj = analyzeExpr(expr, context, oracle);
216        if (conjOrDisj.isLeft()) {
217            if (oracle == null) {
218                conjOrDisj.getLeft().paths.forEach(x -> addEquality(x, context, knowledgeDatabase));
219            } else {
220                conjOrDisj.getLeft().paths.forEach(x -> addEquality(x, context, oracle));
221            }
222        } else {
223            addDisjunction(conjOrDisj.getRight(), context);
224        }
225    }
226
227    private void addDisjunction(Disjunction disj, AstClafer context) {
228        ConstraintDatabase[] disjunction = new ConstraintDatabase[disj.conjunctions.size()];
229        int i = 0;
230        for (Conjunction conjunction : disj.conjunctions) {
231            ConstraintDatabase database = KnowledgeDatabase.or();
232            conjunction.paths.forEach(x -> addEquality(x, context, database));
233            disjunction[i] = database;
234            i++;
235        }
236        assert i == disjunction.length;
237        knowledgeDatabase.newDisjunction(disjunction);
238    }
239
240    private void addEquality(Either<Subset, Equal> constraint, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
241        if (constraint.isLeft()) {
242            Subset subset = constraint.getLeft();
243            Path sub = subset.sub;
244            Domain sup = subset.sup;
245            if (sub instanceof LocalPath || analysis.getGlobalCard(context).getLow() > 0) {
246                oracle.newAssignment(sub, sup);
247            }
248        }
249    }
250
251    private void addEquality(Either<Subset, Equal> constraint, AstClafer context, ConstraintDatabase constraintDatabase) {
252        if (constraint.isLeft()) {
253            Subset subset = constraint.getLeft();
254            Path sub = subset.sub;
255            Domain sup = subset.sup;
256            if (sub instanceof LocalPath || analysis.getGlobalCard(context).getLow() > 0) {
257                constraintDatabase.newAssignment(sub, sup);
258            }
259        } else {
260            Equal equal = constraint.getRight();
261            Path p1 = equal.p1;
262            Path p2 = equal.p2;
263            if (p1 instanceof LocalPath && p2 instanceof LocalPath) {
264                constraintDatabase.newLocalEquality(p1, p2);
265            } else if (p1 instanceof LocalPath || p2 instanceof LocalPath) {
266                Path localPath = p1 instanceof LocalPath ? p1 : p2;
267                Path globalPath = p1 instanceof LocalPath ? p2 : p1;
268                for (AstConcreteClafer sub : AstUtil.getConcreteSubs(asClafer(localPath.getContext()))) {
269                    if (analysis.getGlobalCard(sub).getLow() > 0) {
270                        constraintDatabase.newLocalEquality(
271                                localPath.replaceContext(asConcept(sub)),
272                                globalPath);
273                    }
274                }
275            } else {
276                if (analysis.getGlobalCard(context).getLow() > 0) {
277                    constraintDatabase.newLocalEquality(p1, p2);
278                }
279            }
280        }
281    }
282
283    private Either<Conjunction, Disjunction> analyzeExpr(
284            AstBoolExpr expr, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
285        if (expr instanceof AstSetTest) {
286            AstSetTest compare = (AstSetTest) expr;
287            switch (compare.op()) {
288                case Equal:
289                    List<Either<Subset, Equal>> paths = new ArrayList<>(2);
290                    if (compare.left() instanceof AstJoinRef) {
291                        analyzeEqual((AstJoinRef) compare.left(), compare.right(), context, oracle)
292                                .ifPresent(paths::add);
293                    }
294                    if (compare.right() instanceof AstJoinRef) {
295                        analyzeEqual((AstJoinRef) compare.right(), compare.left(), context, oracle)
296                                .ifPresent(paths::add);
297                    }
298                    return Either.left(new Conjunction(paths));
299            }
300        } else if (expr instanceof AstBoolArithm) {
301            AstBoolArithm boolArithm = (AstBoolArithm) expr;
302            switch (boolArithm.op()) {
303                case And:
304                    List<Either<Subset, Equal>> paths = new ArrayList<>();
305                    for (AstBoolExpr operand : boolArithm.operands()) {
306                        Either<Conjunction, Disjunction> conjOrDisj = analyzeExpr(operand, context, oracle);
307                        if (conjOrDisj.isLeft()) {
308                            paths.addAll(conjOrDisj.getLeft().paths);
309                        }
310                    }
311                    return Either.left(new Conjunction(paths));
312                case Or:
313                    List<Conjunction> conjunctions = new ArrayList<>();
314                    for (AstBoolExpr operand : boolArithm.operands()) {
315                        Either<Conjunction, Disjunction> conjOrDisj = analyzeExpr(operand, context, oracle);
316                        if (conjOrDisj.isLeft()) {
317                            conjunctions.add(conjOrDisj.getLeft());
318                        } else {
319                            conjunctions.addAll(conjOrDisj.getRight().conjunctions);
320                        }
321                    }
322                    return Either.right(new Disjunction(conjunctions));
323            }
324        }
325        return Either.left(new Conjunction(Collections.emptyList()));
326    }
327
328    private Optional<Either<Subset, Equal>> analyzeEqual(
329            AstJoinRef var, AstSetExpr value, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
330        Optional<Path> varPath = asPath(var.deref(), context);
331        if (varPath.isPresent()) {
332            Optional<Domain> valueDomain = asDomain(value, context, oracle);
333            if (valueDomain.isPresent()) {
334                return Optional.of(Either.left(new Subset(varPath.get(), valueDomain.get())));
335            }
336            if (value instanceof AstJoinRef) {
337                Optional<Path> valuePath = asPath((AstJoinRef) value, context);
338                if (valuePath.isPresent()) {
339                    return Optional.of(Either.right(new Equal(varPath.get(), valuePath.get())));
340                }
341            }
342        }
343        return Optional.empty();
344    }
345
346    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstJoinRef ast, AstClafer context) {
347        return asPath(ast.deref(), context);
348    }
349
350    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstSetExpr ast, AstClafer context) {
351        if (ast instanceof AstThis) {
352            return asPath((AstThis) ast, context);
353        }
354        if (ast instanceof AstGlobal) {
355            return asPath((AstGlobal) ast, context);
356        }
357        if (ast instanceof AstConstant) {
358            return asPath((AstConstant) ast, context);
359        }
360        if (ast instanceof AstJoin) {
361            return asPath((AstJoin) ast, context);
362        }
363        if (ast instanceof AstUpcast) {
364            return asPath((AstUpcast) ast, context);
365        }
366        return Optional.empty();
367    }
368
369    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstUpcast ast, AstClafer context) {
370        return asPath(ast.base(), context);
371    }
372
373    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstJoin ast, AstClafer context) {
374        if (ast.right() instanceof AstChildRelation) {
375            AstChildRelation right = (AstChildRelation) ast.right();
376
377            Optional<Path> left = asPath(ast.left(), context);
378            return left.map(x -> x.append(asConcept(right.childType())));
379        }
380        return Optional.empty();
381    }
382
383    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstThis ast, AstClafer context) {
384        return Optional.of(new LocalPath(asConcept(context)));
385    }
386
387    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstGlobal ast, AstClafer context) {
388        return Optional.of(new Path(asConcept(ast.type().getParent()), asConcept(ast.type())));
389    }
390
391    private Optional<Path> asPath(AstConstant ast, AstClafer context) {
392        if (ast.type().isClaferType()) {
393            return Optional.of(new Path(asConcept(ast.type().getClaferType())));
394        }
395        return Optional.empty();
396    }
397
398    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstSetExpr ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
399        if (ast instanceof AstConstant) {
400            return asDomain((AstConstant) ast, context, oracle);
401        }
402        if (ast instanceof AstArithm) {
403            return asDomain((AstArithm) ast, context, oracle);
404        }
405        if (ast instanceof AstMinus) {
406            return asDomain((AstMinus) ast, context, oracle);
407        }
408        if (ast instanceof AstUnion) {
409            return asDomain((AstUnion) ast, context, oracle);
410        }
411        if (ast instanceof AstTernary) {
412            return asDomain((AstTernary) ast, context, oracle);
413        }
414        if (ast instanceof AstUpcast) {
415            return asDomain((AstUpcast) ast, context, oracle);
416        }
417        if (oracle != null && ast instanceof AstJoinRef) {
418            AstJoinRef joinRef = (AstJoinRef) ast;
419            Optional<Path> path = asPath(joinRef.deref(), context);
420            return path.map(oracle::getAssignment);
421        }
422        return Optional.empty();
423    }
424
425    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstConstant ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
426        if (ast.value().length > 0 && ast.value()[0].length == 1) {
427            int[] values = new int[ast.value().length];
428            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
429                values[i] = ast.value()[i][0];
430            }
431            return Optional.of(Domains.enumDomain(values));
432        }
433        return Optional.empty();
434    }
435
436    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstArithm ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
437        int[] operands = new int[ast.operands().length];
438        for (int i = 0; i < operands.length; i++) {
439            Optional<Domain> domain = asDomain(ast.operands()[i], context, oracle);
440            // TODO handle none constants
441            if (!domain.isPresent() || domain.get().size() != 1) {
442                return Optional.empty();
443            }
444            operands[i] = domain.get().getLowBound();
445        }
446        switch (ast.op()) {
447            case Add:
448                return Optional.of(Domains.constantDomain(Util.sum(operands)));
449            case Sub:
450                int difference = operands[0];
451                for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
452                    difference -= operands[i];
453                }
454                return Optional.of(Domains.constantDomain(difference));
455            case Mul:
456                int product = 1;
457                for (int operand : operands) {
458                    product *= operand;
459                }
460                return Optional.of(Domains.constantDomain(product));
461            case Div:
462                int quotient = operands[0];
463                for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
464                    quotient /= operands[i];
465                }
466                return Optional.of(Domains.constantDomain(quotient));
467            default:
468                return Optional.empty();
469        }
470    }
471
472    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstMinus ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
473        Optional<Domain> left = asDomain(ast.expr(), context, oracle);
474        return left.map(Domain::minus);
475    }
476
477    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstUnion ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
478        Optional<Domain> left = asDomain(ast.left(), context, oracle);
479        if (left.isPresent()) {
480            Optional<Domain> right = asDomain(ast.right(), context, oracle);
481            if (right.isPresent()) {
482                return Optional.of(left.get().union(right.get()));
483            }
484        }
485        return Optional.empty();
486    }
487
488    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstTernary ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
489        Optional<Domain> consequent = asDomain(ast.consequent(), context, oracle);
490        if (consequent.isPresent()) {
491            Optional<Domain> alternative = asDomain(ast.alternative(), context, oracle);
492            if (alternative.isPresent()) {
493                return Optional.of(consequent.get().union(alternative.get()));
494            }
495        }
496        return Optional.empty();
497    }
498
499    private Optional<Domain> asDomain(AstUpcast ast, AstClafer context, Oracle oracle) {
500        Optional<Domain> base = asDomain(ast.base(), context, oracle);
501        if (base.isPresent()) {
502            int offset = analysis.getOffset(
503                    ast.target().getClaferType(),
504                    analysis.getType(ast.base()).getClaferType());
505            return Optional.of(base.get().offset(offset));
506        }
507        return Optional.empty();
508    }
509
510    private class LocalPath extends Path {
511
512        public LocalPath(Concept... steps) {
513            super(steps);
514        }
515
516        @Override
517        protected Path newPath(Concept... steps) {
518            return new LocalPath(steps);
519        }
520    }
521
522    private static class Conjunction {
523
524        final List<Either<Subset, Equal>> paths;
525
526        Conjunction(List<Either<Subset, Equal>> paths) {
527            this.paths = paths;
528        }
529    }
530
531    private static class Disjunction {
532
533        final List<Conjunction> conjunctions;
534
535        public Disjunction(List<Conjunction> conjunctions) {
536            this.conjunctions = conjunctions;
537        }
538    }
539
540    private static class Subset {
541
542        final Path sub;
543        final Domain sup;
544
545        Subset(Path sub, Domain sup) {
546            this.sub = sub;
547            this.sup = sup;
548        }
549    }
550
551    private static class Equal {
552
553        final Path p1, p2;
554
555        Equal(Path p1, Path p2) {
556            this.p1 = p1;
557            this.p2 = p2;
558        }
559    }
560}
